1084-4279-6273.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
1084-4279-6273.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
1084-4279-6273.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more loyalty counters on it

1170-1177-5078-8176.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Narset by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to look at the top four cards of your library, then reveal Sensei's Divining Top and put it into your hand.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Narset.
Repeat.

2438-2586-7690--165.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat

6249-6495-7256--5.description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy kicked by paying {2}{B}{R}, creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Warhost's Frenzy's delayed ability trigger.
Resolve the Warhost's Frenzy trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6249-6495-7256--5.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2757-3327-8095.notablePrerequisites:
You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
You control a basic Mountain.
2757-3327-8095.description:
Activate a basic Mountain, adding {R}.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Dargo, untapping a basic Mountain.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

791-6034-8089.easyPrerequisites: Pact Weapon attached to a creature you control.
791-6034-8089.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is a multiple of 3.
791-6034-8089.description:
Activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

4247-5170-6132-6794.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

2292-3197-6012--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reluctant Role Model triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 5.

225-851-3129-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1308-2557-3129-5478-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
1308-2557-3129-5478-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

215-647-1526.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
215-647-1526.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Circle of Dreams Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Circle of Dreams Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2204-2438-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Scholar of New Horizons.
When Scholar of New Horizons dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-1283-7315.easyPrerequisites: Jetfire has no +1/+1 counters on it.
114-1283-7315.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

647-2769-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-2769-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Hanweir Garrison as attackers.
Hanweir Garrison triggers, creating two creature tokens
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

339-677-997-6965.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

38-4063-5220-6900.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Fleshtaker trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3490-4659-6872.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional artifact creature.
3490-4659-6872.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing any other artifact creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Oracle of Mul Daya

907-5449-5702-6763.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
907-5449-5702-6763.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary. When it enters untapped due to Horizon Explorer, Selesnya Sanctuary and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Oracle of Mul Daya.
Because of the additional Oracle of Mul Daya token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

288-3000-4050-6705.description:
Activate Oketra by paying {3}{W}, creating two 1/1 Squirrel, one 1/1 Frog and one 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing the Frog, Squirrels and Warrior, adding {3}{W}.
Repeat.

224-1525-4913-6528.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
224-1525-4913-6528.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand, then put the land onto the battlefield tapped, and repeat this process once if you control at least eight lands.
Retreat to Coralhelm and Elfsworn Giant trigger for each land that enters the battlefield this way.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger(s), untapping Zimone and Dina.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger(s), creating that many creature tokens.
Repeat.

3817-5170-5686.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
3817-5170-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield, and causing you to gain 5 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 2.
Repeat.

1167-2580-5957.description:
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to gain control of target opponent during their next turn.
During the opponent's turn, cast Lethal Vapors by paying {2}{B}{B}.
As the opponent, activate Lethal Vapors by paying {0} an arbitrarily large number of times, causing that opponent to skip that many turns.

1115-2034-2820-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Angelic Renewal.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Yenna, adding {C}{C}.
When Yenna dies, both Angelic Renewals trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to sacrifice either Angelic Renewal and return Yenna from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

2060-2438-2744-3327.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
2060-2438-2744-3327.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

658-1453-3414-4438-4613.notablePrerequisites:
Urza's Saga has two lore counters on it.
Lands you control except Urza's Saga can tap to produce at least {2}.
Your life total is at least 11.
The number of artifacts you control plus Arwen's toughness is equal to or greater than 9.
658-1453-3414-4438-4613.description:
Activate any number of lands except Urza's Saga by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Urza's Saga's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control, and that enters the battlefield with a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Arwen's toughness.
Activate the Construct using Beledros Witherbloom's ability by paying 10 life, untapping all lands you control.
Activate the Construct using Gristleback's ability by sacrificing it, causing you to gain at least 10 life.
Repeat.
If the number of artifacts you control plus Arwen's toughness is equal to or greater than 10, this combo nets infinite life, and if other lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets infinite mana.
If you get infinite life and infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Constructs.

1496-3263-4078-4242-5256.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1496-3263-4078-4242-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Su-Chi.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Su-Chi's power.
Activate Chainer by paying {3} and 3 life, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Su-Chi enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Su-Chi's toughness.
Repeat.

1866-2882-3381-4999.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Morgue Toad.
1866-2882-3381-4999.description:
Cast Sandbar Merfolk either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {U}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Morgue Toad due to Infinite Reflection.
Activate Sandbar Merfolk by sacrificing it, adding {U}{R}.
If you cast Sandbar Merfolk from your graveyard, Sandbar Merfolk is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Sandbar Merfolk's cycling ability.
Repeat.

75-4050-5154.notablePrerequisites: Lingering Tormentor does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
75-4050-5154.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Lingering Tormentor, adding {B/G}.
When Lingering Tormentor dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Quillspike by paying {B/G} and removing the -1/-1 counter from Lingering Tormentor, giving Quillspike +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.

553-742.notablePrerequisites: Your deck size is at least seven.
553-742.description:
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to gain seven life and put Approach of the Second Sun into your library seventh from the top.
Cast Demonic Consultation by paying {B}, exiling the top six cards of your library and then revealing Approach of the Second Sun and putting it into your hand.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to win the game.

1328-2856-3258.notablePrerequisites: Spellbinder attached to a creature you control.The creature with Spellbinder attached does not have summoning sickness, and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1328-2856-3258.description:
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, casting a copy of Mystical Tutor without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Mystical Tutor, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and putting it on top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Beacon of Tomorrows during your draw step.
Repeat.

690-1738-3779.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
690-1738-3779.description:
Cast Swords to Plowshares by paying {W}, exiling Serra Avatar and gaining life equal to its power.
Sanguine Bond triggers, causing target opponent whose lifetotal is less than or equal to Serra Avatar's power to lose life equal to the life you gained.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

3490-4050-5212.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with power one or greater.
3490-4050-5212.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature with power one or greater, adding one mana of any color.
Kresh triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
